dataset_source.title: Sampling the materials space for conventional superconducting compounds
dataset_source.attribution: Source data: Tiago F. T. Cerqueira, Antonio Sanna and Miguel A. L. Marques, Sampling the materials space for conventional superconducting compounds, Materials Cloud 2023.163 v1, DOI 10.24435/materialscloud:qv-bq, CC BY 4.0. This catalogue is a derived projection with additional source-state screening commentary.

scope: Previously private source-model screening is now published as unscored source-computed material-design hypotheses. Historical private-screening wording is retained as context. These predictions are new to this reviewed catalogue only; experimental confirmation, worldwide first discovery, formal RPS and human scientific review are not claimed.
source_tc_scope: Source isotropic Eliashberg Tc in K at mu*=0.1 is a model result, not experimental Tc. It is a separate source product and is not associated with an individual Gaussian width or a numerical uncertainty interval.
pairing_response_scope: Retained ten-width lambda contrasts and independent source Tc products support bounded source-model comparisons. Chemical, mass, volume, sampling, spin and SOC effects can co-change; no universal causal or error-bound interpretation is assigned.
risk_tag_scope: Attention labels support browsing. Element labels are not measured magnetic ground states, rejection criteria or calibrated potential scores; no label does not mean no risk.

candidate.prototype: Pm-3m ordered rock-salt-derived eight-site ScZr3N4: Sc corner, three Zr face centers, N three edge centers plus body center
candidate.prototype_evidence: Pm-3m ordered rock-salt-derived eight-site ScZr3N4: Sc corner, three Zr face centers, N three edge centers plus body center
candidate.support_meaning: Preliminary screened support within the stated source model. This ordinal level is not a probability, formal RPS score or human scientific review.
candidate.risk_summary: Source Gamma optical compression and sampled path are stable at the stated scalar approximation. Fine pressure is -0.205 GPa despite zero symmetry-constrained forces. ScHf3N4 has larger lambda but lower separate Eli Tc, and already accepted YZr3N4 has substantially larger lambda; both controls are retained. Nitrogen vacancies, ordered-cation disorder, charge redistribution and alternate nitrides are appropriate falsifiers. No pure volume-only causal claim or inherited YZr3N4 qualification is used.
candidate.ambient_scope: Both source SCFs converge, near-zero coarse forces/stress and bounded fine response are measured. Fine Fmax=0 eV/A, P=-0.205 GPa, full max stress=0.205 GPa. Gamma optical compression is positive beyond printing bound and sampled path has no signed negative values. All listed q outputs have JOBDONE/last response convergence and no routine errors. This supports a finite-grid local/metastable source model, not global hull or experimental synthesis.
candidate.route_response: Sc replaces Hf on the single cation corner site while three Zr and all four N sites remain mapped. The volume contracts 0.5685%, Sc-N versus Hf-N falls 0.0043104 A and Zr-N also falls 0.0043104 A. All ten lambda values improve 6.741–28.257% and separate Eli mu=.1 rises 14.993 to 16.568 K. This is a coupled cation/network intervention; the valence change is not converted to mobile n.
candidate.next_action: Cross the Sc/Hf unique-site substitution with a fixed-volume comparison and test the lowest N-vacancy/order competitor. A stable coupling gain at common source method supports screening; a missing metallic channel, unfavorable ordering basin or reversed paired response opposes it.

seven_criteria.identity: Complete ordered CIF/literal coarse-fine input/Gamma periodic species-site association is numerically supported; source input geometry and full tensor/forces are retained. Export occupancy is a discrete computational convention; source experimental P/T/occupancy and actual compiled unit constant are unknown. Exact-version input defaults scope the configured neutral scalar spin1/noSOC model, not magnetic ground state.
seven_criteria.quantitative_route_response: Sc replaces Hf on the single cation corner site while three Zr and all four N sites remain mapped. The volume contracts 0.5685%, Sc-N versus Hf-N falls 0.0043104 A and Zr-N also falls 0.0043104 A. All ten lambda values improve 6.741–28.257% and separate Eli mu=.1 rises 14.993 to 16.568 K. This is a coupled cation/network intervention; the valence change is not converted to mobile n.
seven_criteria.pairing_relevance: Exact target and mapped control direct source lambda arrays have the same favorable sign at all ten common broadening tokens; omega_ln has explicit K units and separate Eli/McM mu=.1 tables remain independent. Same underlying q mesh is observed. The sensitivity range is not a physical error bound; sigma units, full-BZ convergence, experimental Tc and pure-geometry causality remain unknown. Literal method differences are declared confounds.
seven_criteria.ambient_feasibility: Both source SCFs converge, near-zero coarse forces/stress and bounded fine response are measured. Fine Fmax=0 eV/A, P=-0.205 GPa, full max stress=0.205 GPa. Gamma optical compression is positive beyond printing bound and sampled path has no signed negative values. All listed q outputs have JOBDONE/last response convergence and no routine errors. This supports a finite-grid local/metastable source model, not global hull or experimental synthesis.
seven_criteria.competition_and_coherence: Source Gamma optical compression and sampled path are stable at the stated scalar approximation. Fine pressure is -0.205 GPa despite zero symmetry-constrained forces. ScHf3N4 has larger lambda but lower separate Eli Tc, and already accepted YZr3N4 has substantially larger lambda; both controls are retained. Nitrogen vacancies, ordered-cation disorder, charge redistribution and alternate nitrides are appropriate falsifiers. No pure volume-only causal claim or inherited YZr3N4 qualification is used.
seven_criteria.novelty: ScZr3N4 is a published computational prediction in the 2023 primary screening study, with SG221 and separate hull/coupling model data. It is not first predicted here. The 2026-10-07 bounded exact-phase review found no experimental superconducting ScZr3N4 benchmark. Novelty is the matched Sc-for-Hf corner-site source construction in this reviewed catalogue.
seven_criteria.decision: Cross the Sc/Hf unique-site substitution with a fixed-volume comparison and test the lowest N-vacancy/order competitor. A stable coupling gain at common source method supports screening; a missing metallic channel, unfavorable ordering basin or reversed paired response opposes it.
